# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go to the latest release of the current major line.

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| 1.x (latest) | Yes |
| < 1.0 | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Report privately through GitHub's vulnerability reporting: the **Security** tab of this repository, then **Report a vulnerability**.

Expect a first reply within 7 days. A fix is released as a patch version, and the advisory names the affected versions. Accepted reports are credited in the advisory unless you ask otherwise. Declined reports get a short explanation.
